unit: $/ea (one complete motorised door unit, supplied, installed and commissioned into a prepared opening, 4.0 x 4.5 m)

band.unit: $/ea (one complete motorised door unit, supplied, installed and commissioned into a prepared opening, 4.0 x 4.5 m)
band.basis: Sum of the nine components above, Auckland, GST exclusive, margin and preliminaries excluded. Nominal quantity 4 identical doors installed in one visit: total $43,040 low / $67,480 high (midpoint $55,240); scissor lift and delivery are amortised across the four doors, all other components are per door. Largest line is the door unit plus its insulated-aluminium upgrade ($8,360–$11,520, ~78–68% of the low/high totals), which rests on a cited QV row with a stated percentage adjustment, so the band is established. Allowances (controls, delivery, commissioning) carry 9–14% of the total, under a third. Band is wide because the material upgrade is a percentage from a retail source and the controls have no published NZ rate. Installation labour, fixings and packers are assumed already inside the QV door rate and have NOT been added again — if that rate proves to be supply-only, add $450–$900/door.

Per-door rate for one complete motorised insulated roller shutter, 4.0m x 4.5m (18 m2) structural opening, supplied, installed and commissioned into a prepared reinforced opening, on a nominal quantity of 4 identical doors in one Auckland visit. Sum of the seven components above (low column = $11,570; high column = $18,730); midpoint $15,150/ea. Four-door total: $46,280 low, $74,920 high, approximately $60,600 at the midpoint - the scissor-lift and delivery components are already divided by 4 so this total is auditable. Primary basis is QV CostBuilder: a steel interlocking-slat roller shutter row used as a proxy for the insulated aluminium slat with a stated +35% to +100% adjustment, QV three-phase mechanism and motorised-control rows, and a QV scissor-lift row. Corroborating fetched pages: NZ supply price for a 4.5m-high steel shutter (DoorsNZ, source-2) and an Australian insulated-door / installed-roller-shutter band (whatsthedamage, source-3). Allowances are about 10-13% of the band, so the band is not allowance-driven; the risk sits in the insulated-slat premium on the QV steel proxy. GST exclusive; preliminaries, margin, design and consent fees, the structural opening, the 3-phase supply/isolator/submain, vision panels, wicket doors, fire or cyclone rating, remote controls, loop detectors, painting and any service contract are excluded per the fixed scope. Not a certified price - confirm with two door suppliers and one installer before committing.
